headline: Funding for Kennedy Schoolyard renovation, Union Square Plaza, Somerville Armory, and 277 Broadway restoration.
summary: The agenda includes six grant requests and ten requests to use Community Preservation Act funds. Other items cover salary changes, a contract extension, and two agreements.
items: Accept and spend a $50,000 state grant for the Somerville Mobile Farmers Market
Accept and spend a $50,000 state grant for school-based food access programs
Time-only contract extension for Water & Sewer printing and mailing services with D3 Logic Inc.
Accept and spend a $48,000 state grant for recycling and waste reduction, including food waste containers
Accept and spend a $500,000 federal grant for Union Square Plaza Phase 1 Project
Accept and spend a $350,000 state grant for the Massachusetts Downtown Initiative Capital Grant Improvement
Use $12,075 in departmental salary funds to adjust Fiscal Year 2027 salaries after the departmental reorganization
Use $25,950 in police salary and lump sum funds to correct grading of the Victim Witness Advocate and Senior Crime Analyst positions
Accept and spend a $60,313.17 state grant for the Municipal Road Safety Grant Program
Transfer $23,418.40 from Community Preservation Act undesignated fund balance to the Historic Preservation Reserve
Appropriate $1,000,000 from the Community Preservation Act Open Space Reserve to complete renovation of Kennedy Schoolyard
Appropriate $1,000,000 from Community Preservation Act undesignated fund balance to the Open Space Reserve
Appropriate $109,000 from the Historic Preservation Reserve for a Historic Exterior Needs Assessment of the Somerville Armory
Appropriate $45,000 from the Open Space Reserve to design a neighborhood green space at Spring Street traffic island
Appropriate $38,000 from the Historic Preservation Reserve to restore Veterans Cemetery
Appropriate $25,000 from the Historic Preservation Reserve for a condition assessment of the Mission Church of Christ building at 130 Highland Ave.
Appropriate $230,171 from the Historic Preservation Reserve for exterior restoration of 277 Broadway

Repurpose $15,154.25 from a Fiscal Year 2025 Community Preservation Act grant for Elizabeth Peabody House from siding replacement to structural reinforcement
First Amendment to Easement and License Agreement for 74 Middlesex Avenue
Urban Center Housing Tax Increment Financing (UCH-TIF) Agreement for Block 9 - Assembly Square
